US-Iran Meeting Claims Differ Amid Tensions

US President Donald Trump stated Iran requested a meeting, with some reports indicating talks were set for Tuesday in Doha. However, Iranian officials have denied any such meeting is scheduled, with one official stating Iran canceled participation in technical talks over recent attacks. The conflicting statements emerge as hostilities have mounted in the Strait of Hormuz and Iran's Supreme Leader called for legal action over alleged US-Israeli war crimes.
